title: MCP
description: Connect WakeMark to AI agents with the Model Context Protocol.
subtitle: Let agents like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor search, read and organize your X bookmarks through a secure MCP server.
docsHint: Step-by-step setup guide and tool reference:

endpoint.title: Server URL
endpoint.description: Point your MCP client at this Streamable HTTP endpoint and authenticate with an API key below.

keys.title: API Keys
keys.description: Each key grants full access to your WakeMark data via MCP. Treat keys like passwords.
keys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to connect your first MCP client.
keys.createDescription: Give the key a name so you can tell clients apart later.
keys.createdDescription: Copy the key now. For security it will not be shown again.
keys.revokeConfirmDescription: Clients using this key will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.

clients.title: Connect an MCP client
clients.description: Copy the config for your client. The placeholder key is replaced automatically once you create a key above.
clients.chatgptSteps: ChatGPT has no config file: open Settings > Connectors > Advanced, add a custom connector with the Server URL above, and paste your API key when asked for authentication.
clients.claudeCodeHint: Run this command in your terminal.

tools.description: What agents can do once connected.
